front: When was the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child adopted?

back: A person under the age of 18.

front: Name five children's rights in the Constitution.
back: Name and birth registration; family care; education, health care, nutrition and shelter; protection from exploitation and abuse; best interests paramount.
Respect parents and elders; attend school; respect others' rights; obey the law; care for health and the environment.
A legal restriction on a right, allowed only when fair, reasonable and necessary, e.g. for public health or the rights of others.

front: What did the Constitutional Court rule in 2016?
back: That no one may marry before the age of 18.

front: Name two rights that may never be limited.
back: Freedom from torture and freedom from slavery (also the right to a fair trial).
